{{Quote|Yes, yes, all very interesting, I'm sure. But enough talk of business. You're not eating your quaffles. Try them: they're quite good. First you bite their heads off to stop them from squiggling around so much...|Moren Chonk|<ref name="Death in the Undercity">''[[Death in the Undercity]]''</ref>}}
A '''quaffle''' was a type of creature. The [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] [[Moren Chonk]] liked to eat quaffles.

==Behind the scenes==
The quaffle was mentioned in a quote attributed to [[Moren Chonk]] in his character profile in ''[[Death in the Undercity]]''. When the adventure was republished in ''[[Classic Adventures: Volume Three]]'', the quote was removed from Chonk's profile.
